prompt.description: Draws the shell prompt. Only one prompt engine may own the prompt function.

project-env.description: Loads per-directory environment variables. Two active hooks would fight over the same variables.

navigation.description: Jumps to frequently used directories. Hooks the prompt to track directory changes.

listing.description: Lists directory contents. The winner defines ls, ll, la, tree and ff.

words.color: color when the terminal supports it
words.icons: icons when the terminal supports them
words.long: one row per entry, with details

pager.description: Pages long output. The winner sets PAGER, which DotForge's own pager also reads.

diff.description: Displays git diffs. The winner sets GIT_PAGER.

picker.requires: Accepts fzf's command-line options and reads candidates on stdin.
picker.description: Fuzzy-picks from a list. The winner sets Picker, which every DotForge picker runs.

editor.description: Edits text files. The winner sets EDITOR and VISUAL.

package-manager.description: Installs tools. Install-DFTool tries the winner first, then the others by priority.

tab-completion.description: Owns the Tab key. The winner binds Tab; the others still register their completers.

url-fetch.description: Downloads files and calls HTTP APIs.

version-manager.description: Installs and switches language runtime versions.

js-runtime.description: Provides a JavaScript runtime on PATH (node, bun). Tools that need one declare requires: ["role:js-runtime"].

elevator.description: Runs a command with administrator rights. Install-DFTool runs a manager that needs admin (choco) through it.

python-runtime.description: Provides a Python runtime on PATH. Tools that need one declare requires: ["role:python-runtime"].

python-package-manager.description: Installs packages from PyPI. Install-DFTool uses the Defaults choice, else the highest priority (uv, pipx, pip).

js-package-manager.description: Installs packages from the npm registry. Install-DFTool uses the Defaults choice, else the highest priority.

powershell-package-manager.description: Installs modules from the PowerShell Gallery.
